text:
I need to walk along the sidewalk

somewhere

on a shady afternoon

find a table

on the terrace of a café

sit down

order a drink

and I want to sit there

with that drink

and I want

a fly to land

on that table.

Then

I want to see

a woman walk past

in a green dress.

I want to see pass by

a fat dog

with short brown hair and

smiling eyes.

I want to die

sitting there.

I want to die

upright

my eyes still

open.

I want an airplane

to fly overhead.

I want a woman

to pass by

in a blue dress.

Then I want

that same dog

with short brown hair and

smiling eyes

to walk past

again.

That will be

enough

after all the

other things

and all the

rest.

translation.title: I Need to Walk Along the Sidewalk...
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version of Charles Bukowski. The deliberately spare one-line stanzas and repeated phrasing are preserved.
